description.value: Meadow Park Sports Centre is Whistler's primary municipal recreation facility, operated by the Resort Municipality of Whistler on shared L̓il̓wat7úl and Sḵwx̱wú7mesh territory. The centre offers a swimming pool, indoor ice skating, weight room, fitness classes, and squash courts, making it a multi-sport hub for both residents and visitors. For touring cyclists, it sits on Highway 99 and represents a rare full-service recreation stop in the Sea-to-Sky corridor.
